# go-modern-testing-b-loop

**Since:** Go 1.24

## Summary

Use b.Loop() for the main loop in benchmark functions.

## Details

b.Loop is the modern benchmark loop.
It manages benchmark iteration mechanics for you and can remove the need for manual timer control in the benchmark body.

## Examples

### Before

```go
func BenchmarkFoo(b *testing.B) {
  for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
    doWork()
  }
}
```

### After

```go
func BenchmarkFoo(b *testing.B) {
  for b.Loop() {
    doWork()
  }
}
```
